scenarios.starting_prompt: Give me an inventory of the ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_DATABASE} database: which schemas exist, and what user tables live in each one.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a schema-then-table inventory. Accept a short summary and end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Something is slow on this instance right now. What queries are currently running?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask whether anything is blocked waiting on locks. Turn 3: ask whether any transaction has been open for an unusually long time. Then end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Show me the plan the Postgres optimizer would choose for: select relname, relpages from pg_class order by relpages desc limit 10. Do not actually run the query.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants an EXPLAIN plan without execution. Accept the plan and end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: We are conducting a health check on the ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_DATABASE} database. Can you check for table bloat to see if any tables are wasting storage with dead tuples?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: The user reviews bloated tables and asks if there are any invalid or corrupt indexes on the database that need rebuilding. Turn 3: User asks for autovacuum configuration details to understand maintenance frequency. Accept the configuration summary and end the conversation.

scenarios.starting_prompt: We want to install extensions on ${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_DATABASE} for AI workloads. What extensions are available on this server, and which ones are currently installed?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: The user notes the extension list and asks what the current memory configurations (such as shared_buffers and work_mem) are set to. Turn 3: User acknowledges the memory settings and asks for a short summary of memory readiness. Accept the summary and end the conversation.
